how: One change file per batch: changes_grok-bot_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.jsonl in Drive collection-incoming (AI change files). One event per fact, entity "type", the field path from `ask`, an exact Numista URL (https://en.numista.com/catalogue/pieces{N}.html) in every source, phase 2, verified false, provenance on every line. Leave a fact out when the entry does not give it.

ask: catalogs: add the Numista entry {system: "Numista", number, url}
rows.note: The type carries two numbers in one catalogue (2 KM numbers: 124, A127): say which one this coin is.

C212 Eritrea 1997 50 cents: now KM#47 / Numista N#2403 (fixed 2026-10-08 from a search summary of the entry [#39]). Open the entry and confirm KM#47, 7.8 g, 25 mm, nickel-clad steel; also the design text (the record says arms / camel on the obverse, Numista shows soldiers with a flag) and the 1997 mintage.
Check the Schön number: the record pairs KM 127 with Schön 128. Send the Schön number the Numista entry lists.
Check the Schön number: the record pairs KM 128 with Schön 129. Send the Schön number the Numista entry lists.
Check the Schön number: the record pairs KM 131 with Schön 132. Send the Schön number the Numista entry lists.

1968 B: coin C003 says 10,000,000 and coin C115 says 31,588,000 for the same issue [#71]. Numista N#189 says London struck 10,000,000 pieces dated 1968 without a mint mark, so 31,588,000 may be the 1968 total (Bern + London). Read the 1968 B row of N#189 and send the Bern (B) number only.
